description: A market from the Market custom table (cso.TblCustom_Market), listed in the BIWW Users tab Market filter, that already has at least one user on the store; optionally different from another alias's market. Not MARKET_WITHOUT_USERS. Story BMP-38.

store.description: Store code of the storefront under test (cso.TblCustom_UserManagement.StoreCode, e.g. the BIWW store)

excludeMarket.description: Market name the result must differ from (link to another alias's marketName for a second market). Left out: any
